observations.method: Assistant visual inspection using view_image of the generated native PDF picture
findings: Three labeled Cycle nodes and three closing arrows are visible. Labels may wrap; no calibrated geometry or editability conclusion.

observations.method: Assistant visual inspection using view_image of the generated native PDF picture
findings: Two labeled Process cards and a connecting arrow are visible.
The right card extends beyond the source frame right edge (620 page points); numeric FODP observations flag three out-of-frame boxes for this input.
This is an observed frame/layout limitation, not a calibrated native-versus-PPTKit geometry comparison.

limitations: Manual picture review only, not automated clipping detection or native interactive editing.
Three pictures only (two Cycle and one Process); findings are not extended to all layouts/corpus images.
